### Are You Emotionally Crippled?
Author: Sharon Jaynes
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/girlfriends/girlfriends-in-god-march-13-2019.html
Passage: Luke 13:12
Points:
- Biblical figures were real individuals whose suffering mirrors our own burdens.
- Emotional trauma, shame, and regret can bend and cripple a person's spirit.
- Satan uses heavy burdens to immobilize us, but Jesus came to destroy the enemy's work.
- Christ's release brings not only freedom from past chains, but freedom to live an abundant life.

### When the Struggles of Life Knock You Over
Author: Leah DiPascal
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-october-24-2016.html
Passage: Luke 13:12-13
Points:
- Despite years of exhausting suffering, the woman chose to draw near to Jesus in the synagogue.
- Jesus saw her in the crowd and called her forward with compassion rather than shame.
- Christ's spoken declaration and gentle touch immediately broke eighteen years of physical bondage.
- Standing upright for the first time, her immediate response was worshipful praise to God.
- Believers carrying heavy burdens can trust that Jesus sees their struggles and offers restorative healing.
